overview: This 546-page file tracks Japanese merchant vessels through global ports in spring and early summer 1941. Consular telegrams and Navy paraphrases document routes, cargoes, passengers, tankers, and bills of health. Related records address strategic mineral and oil shipments, controls on ship supplies, customs disputes, and the requisition and recall of Japanese vessels.
interest: Paired consular reports and Navy paraphrases reveal how U.S. officials tracked Japanese shipping and strategic cargoes before war.
